title: Base44 Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Base44 is a solid AI app builder, but it falls short on design flexibility, subscription billing, and developer handoff. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Base44's three biggest gaps natively, from-brief design instead of a template gallery, native Stripe subscription billing instead of a founder wiring it by hand, and two-way GitHub sync on every plan instead of gated behind a $40/mo tier, and it's a more complete platform overall: native mobile apps, a customer-facing AI gateway, built-in growth tooling, and human support when you're stuck are all things Base44 doesn't offer at any tier. More options are listed in our[Base44 alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/base44-alternatives) roundup.
